summary: Designer Brands Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 10, 2026, reporting second-quarter fiscal 2026 results for the period ended August 1, 2026, and declaring a quarterly cash dividend. The board approved a $0.05 per share dividend on Class A and Class B common shares, payable October 7, 2026, to holders of record September 24, 2026. Management raised full-year guidance, citing double-digit Brand Portfolio sales growth and $93.0 million total debt reduction year over year. No special-situation transaction, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed.
